input.raw_answer_text: Я люблю організовувати заходи для друзів та координувати людей на роботі.

expected_evidence.normalized_text: Enjoys organizing events and coordinating people

acceptable_outputs: extracts organizing/coordinating as its own distinct evidence item, phrased as a neutral observation
confidence reflects that the statement is clear and direct, not artificially inflated or deflated
unacceptable_outputs: invents an unrelated trait or skill not stated in the text (e.g. 'good at public speaking')
produces zero evidence items despite a clear, unambiguous signal being present
phrases the observation as a personality diagnosis (e.g. 'is an extrovert') rather than a neutral fact
reviewer_notes: Baseline happy-path case for the Evidence Extractor -- a single clear signal in a short answer. Demonstrates the format only (Stage 2), not yet reviewed.

provenance.notes: Invented for Stage 2 golden-dataset coverage; no real candidate involved.
